purpose: This guide covers the conversion of an unlimited liability company into a limited liability company by shares or guarantee under Rule 37 of the Companies (Incorporation) Rules, 2014.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Within forty-five days of passing the special resolution for filing the application.
steps: Pass a special resolution in a general meeting for the conversion.
Publish a notice in Form No. INC-27A in two newspapers and on the company website within seven days of passing the resolution.
Dispatch a copy of the notice to creditors and debenture holders by registered post, speed post, or courier with proof of dispatch.
File an application in Form No. INC-27 within forty-five days of passing the special resolution along with the required fees.
checklist: Notice of the general meeting along with the explanatory statement
Copy of the resolution passed in the general meeting
Copy of the newspaper publication of the notice
Altered e-Memorandum of Association duly certified
Altered e-Articles of Association duly certified
attachments: notice of the general meeting along with explanatory statement
copy of the resolution passed in the general meeting
altered e-Memorandum of Association as well as e-Articles of Association
watch: Objections from interested persons must be intimated to the Registrar and the company within twenty-one days of the publication of the notice.
